Ana (All-Hands): Quick thread to capture questions from the live Q&A about the outage RCA and next steps. Please keep replies short and paste links to PRs/issues.

Tess (CTO): RCA uploaded: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0501 :link:
One-liner: degraded routing table + unexpected headroom exhaustion on a new autoscale policy during a traffic spike.

Marta (SRE): Can we confirm whether Dedicated customers were affected? Need a sentence for the customer note.

Tess (CTO): Dedicated pools remained segregated; only hosted default routing saw the latency/throughput impact. We'll include that exactly.

Diego (Platform): Short mitigation list we executed: pinned traffic to stable router version, increased regional headroom, and rolled back autoscaler tweak. I'll own a follow PR to make that autoscale tweak gated.

Marta (SRE): I'll add a short oncall playbook snippet. Quick draft below for review:
```
Trigger: token latency > 2x baseline + failed fallback from router
Checks: check router diff (git), autoscale metrics (headroom), regional pool sizes
Immediate: revert autoscale change, force-route traffic, scale headroom
Follow: attach logs, notify infra and open RCA link
```

Lina (CS): ETA on customer note? We need a draft to share with AEs.

Ana (All-Hands): Drafting now. Will post in #customer-comms in 2 hours with the RCA link and a short FAQ. Lina, can you add specific wording for enterprise Dedicated customers?

Lina (CS): Will do. Suggest: "Dedicated customers were isolated and did not experience reduced throughput; hosted customers using default routing may have seen increased latencies."

Tess (CTO): Action owners and rough ETAs from the all-hands:
- Gate autoscaler changes with canary + CI check 1
owner: Diego 1
ETA: 10 days.
- Add router-diff CI validation 1
owner: Marta 1
ETA: 7 days.
- Runbook snippet + oncall training session 1
owner: Marta 1
ETA: 4 days.
- Customer comms draft + AE outreach 1
owner: Ana + Lina 1
ETA: 48h.

Diego (Platform): I've opened the first PR for gating: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/4602 1
proto checks enabled.

Marta (SRE): Router-diff issue: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/802 1
adding validation job.

Ana (All-Hands): Thanks. Please paste follow-up tickets/PRs here as they're created so leadership can track. I'll consolidate into the follow-up doc and share on Friday.

Lina (CS): Added a short FAQ for AEs in #customer-comms. Tagging product for accuracy.

Tess (CTO): Also important: let's add metric guards for autoscale headroom (e.g., min available GPUs per region) so we don't hit zero headroom. Can someone own an infra metric spec?

Diego (Platform): I'll own the metric spec doc. Creating ticket now: https://trello.internal/redwood/c/141-autoscale-metrics-spec 1
ETA: 5 days.

Marta (SRE): We'll schedule a 30-min oncall walk-through next week to run the playbook live. Invite will go out after PRs land.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0501 marked RESOLVED. RCA and timeline: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0501

Ana (All-Hands): Final note: please post short status updates in this thread (PR created, tests passing, docs updated) so the follow-up doc shows progress. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
